tooltip.isekai_mahou.shrine_altar: Heart of an Elemental Shrine. Touch it to begin the Trial of Awakening.
message.isekai_mahou.shrine.title: ✦ %s — Trial of Awakening ✦
message.isekai_mahou.shrine.info: Defeat 3 waves of %s creatures without dying or leaving the shrine. Other players can help by touching the altar.
message.isekai_mahou.shrine.info_awakene: You have already awakened %s: the trial still grants the shrine's rewards.
message.isekai_mahou.shrine.confirm: Touch the altar again to begin the trial.
message.isekai_mahou.shrine.completed: You have already passed the trial of the %s.
message.isekai_mahou.shrine.other_trial: You are already taking part in another trial.
message.isekai_mahou.shrine.in_progress: The trial is under way: defeat the creatures!
message.isekai_mahou.shrine.joined: You joined the trial of the %s! Help defeat the creatures.
message.isekai_mahou.shrine.final_wave: Final wave! A Shrine Champion approaches!
message.isekai_mahou.shrine.fail.died: You fell during the trial of the %s.
message.isekai_mahou.shrine.fail.left: You left the %s: the trial failed.
message.isekai_mahou.shrine.fail.offline: The trial of the %s was interrupted.
message.isekai_mahou.shrine.fail.interru: The altar of the %s went dark: the trial was interrupted.
message.isekai_mahou.shrine.fail.aborted: The trial of the %s was cancelled.
message.isekai_mahou.shrine.fail.gave_up: You gave up the trial of the %s.
message.isekai_mahou.shrine.fail.peacefu: The shrine's creatures do not answer on Peaceful difficulty — the trial of the %s was interrupted.
message.isekai_mahou.shrine.retry: You can try again whenever you like.
message.isekai_mahou.shrine.success: You passed the trial of the %s! The element %s answers your call.
message.isekai_mahou.shrine.helper: You helped pass the trial (you had already completed this shrine).
message.isekai_mahou.shrine.peaceful: The Awakening Trial cannot be taken on Peaceful difficulty.
message.isekai_mahou.shrine.quit_hint: To give up, sneak and touch the altar with an empty hand.
message.isekai_mahou.shrine.updraft: The Peak's currents carry you back to the altar! (%s left)
message.isekai_mahou.shrine.updraft_last: The Peak's currents carry you back to the altar... for the last time!
cutscene.isekai_mahou.shrine.subtitle: Trial of Awakening
command.isekai_mahou.shrine.none: You are not in any shrine trial.
